title: Product Enquiry
body:
I wonder, if all of humanity disappeared,
there would be somewhere
memories, ideas, thoughts?
Our imaginary self.

It's not so practical
from the point of view that yes, obviously, based on modern science
these are artifacts of the brain.

I raise an issue that is transcendent,
governing our species
People who lived in areas so far apart,
that even today with the convenience of the means of transport can not easily be approached with each other,
have developed over the centuries
languages, culture, religion, technology,
and all this with common operating mechanisms.

And I'm not talking about nearby cultures,
who were easier to communicate with.

I would say that even now this is observed, of course with arguments very easily downgraded due to the phenomenon of direct information.

Is there
a common repository of ideas
that all people share
regardless of culture?

A common database,
which we all have access to
through an interhuman internet.

And when we leave, do they leave too?
And if not, then do they pre-exist us?

Product Enquiry

PS: And for lovers of black mirrors and the like:
what if our lives are the internet made by others?

85 — m
